observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two controllers: one black, one with colorful paint splatter design. The console has visible wear and scratches. A power cable and a UK-style plug are present.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a top-down angle, with the PS4 logo visible on the top left. The controllers are placed on top, and the power cable is visible on the right.
Photo 2 shows the console from a front angle, with the colorful controller on top and the black controller below. The PS4 logo is visible on the top right. The power cable is on the right side.
All photos show the console and controllers from different angles, but no screen, no internal view, no disc drive, no game library, no power-on test, no HDMI or USB ports shown.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not a 'Fat' variant (which is a different model with a larger form factor).
The controllers are standard DualShock 4 style, not the 'Fat' controllers which are larger and have a different design.
The seller claims it is a 'PS4 Fat 500GB — Hacked & Fully Working', but no screen or interface is shown to verify functionality.

claims.evidence: No screen or interface shown to verify functionality. No proof of hacking or game library. The console appears to be a standard PS4, not a 'Fat' model.

claims.claim: Selling my PS4 Fat 500GB in good working condition.
claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show a standard PS4 console, not a 'Fat' model. The 'Fat' model is a different physical design with a larger form factor and different controller. The console shown is a standard PS4, not a 'Fat'.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
